proof_body:
by
  intro G _ p hp hG
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  haveI : Fact (Nat.card G).Prime := ⟨hG ▸ hp⟩
  exact ⟨isCyclic_of_prime_card hG, fun H => H.eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_prime_card, fun g hg => zpowers_eq_top_of_prime_card hG hg⟩
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (p : ℕ), p.Prime → Nat.card G = p → IsCyclic G ∧ (∀ H : Subgroup G, H = ⊥ ∨ H = ⊤) ∧ (∀ g : G, g ≠ 1 → Subgroup.zpowers g = ⊤)
